visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a ring, stands in the aisle of a brightly lit convenience store. He holds a green and red Häagen-Dazs Matcha Berry ice cream box close to the lens, smiling widely with visible teeth. Shelves behind him are packed with colorful beverage bottles and snacks. (2) The camera transitions as his hand reaches into a freezer case packed with chocolate-covered bars. He selects one specific Matcha Berry box and places it into a red plastic shopping basket. The lighting is bright and industrial, reflecting off the glass of the freezer and the product packaging. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor sidewalk at night. The man is seen in a medium close-up, biting into the green ice cream bar with significant enthusiasm. He looks at the camera with wide eyes and a joyful expression. The background consists of a dimly lit street with car headlights and orange traffic cones. (4) An extreme close-up shot focuses on the ice cream bar itself, which has been bitten to reveal internal layers: a light green matcha ice cream center with a dark red berry jam swirl, all encased in a pale green outer coating. The man holds the bar against a background of grey stone tiles. (5) Returning to a selfie-style shot outdoors, the man continues to speak and eat the bar, gesturing with his free hand. He looks happy and satisfied. The video concludes with a product shot of the ice cream bar's embossed surface and the man making a 'recommend' gesture while holding the wrapper.
